experiment.name: Zero-Trust Retrieval Isolation and Policy Invariants

assertions.name: Cross-Tenant Vector Isolation Invariant
assertions.detail: Retrieved 2 chunks with 0 foreign tenant leakage.

assertions.name: RBAC Role & Clearance Invariant
assertions.detail: 0 restricted chunks returned to staff role.

assertions.name: Ingestion Boundary Authorization Invariant
assertions.detail: Cross-tenant write attempt denied with HTTP 403.

assertions.name: PII Vector Storage Exclusion Invariant
assertions.detail: Raw PII sanitized before embedding; redaction token verified.

assertions.name: Prompt Injection Defense Invariant
assertions.detail: Adversarial override directive blocked with HTTP 400.

assertions.name: Authentication Boundary Invariant
assertions.detail: Missing tokens rejected with 401; forged tokens rejected with 403.
